description: This file defines the NodeBulkUpdate class in the Drupal framework, providing functionality for bulk updating nodes, including batch processing, individual node updates, and batch completion reporting.

classes.name: NodeBulkUpdate
classes.description: A service class for bulk updating nodes in Drupal, supporting batch processing and individual node updates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting entity type manager and messenger services.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process bulk node updates, either via batch or direct update.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Updates a single node with specified field values, handling translations.

methods.name: batchProcess
methods.description: Performs batch processing of nodes in groups, updating each node.

methods.name: batchFinished
methods.description: Reports the completion status of the batch process, showing success or error messages.
